policy_comparisons.frozen_plan: Missing, skipped, malformed, unreconciled, or environment-incomparable evidence is unavailable and cannot count as zero or PASS.
policy_comparisons.reviewed: Missing, skipped, malformed, unreconciled, or environment-incomparable evidence is unavailable and cannot count as zero or PASS.

policy_comparisons.frozen_plan: Synthetic/fixture evidence may authorize only structural claims. Wall-clock, provider, context-cost, or rework claims require actual execution evidence and are shadow-only in v0.11.
policy_comparisons.reviewed: Synthetic/fixture evidence may authorize only structural claims. Wall-clock, provider, context-cost, or rework claims require actual execution evidence and are shadow-only in v0.11.

policy_comparisons.frozen_plan: Serial control and optimized plans must preserve an identical obligation_set_hash and identical mandatory quality-gate set before empirical comparison is valid.

policy_comparisons.frozen_plan: Integration completeness denominator is the fixed 23-source-task universe, never emitted workstream count. Every emitted workstream must identify >=1 source_task_ids, and every source task must be covered.
policy_comparisons.reviewed: Integration completeness denominator is the fixed 23-source-task universe, never emitted workstream count. Every emitted workstream must identify >=1 source_task_ids, and every source task must be covered.

policy_comparisons.frozen_plan: Every execution fixture is eligible. Critical-path truth is the set of ALL maximum-total-work paths in the effective DAG after mechanically derived conflict-serialization edges; set equality is required.
